items.headline: Council to hear appeal of Civic Center Drive townhome project
items.summary: The City Council is set to hear an appeal of a permit approval for demolishing existing buildings at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street to build 14 townhomes and a duplex with commercial space.

items.headline: Public meeting on Oakmead Parkway housing project's environmental review
items.summary: The city held a public scoping meeting on Monday, August 24, 2026 for the environmental impact report on a proposed residential project at 1250 Oakmead Parkway, giving residents a chance to weigh in on what the review should study.
